purpose: Idempotent module/knowledge-graph routing without duplicating the canonical source record.

routeId.purpose: Idempotent edge identity. Reprocessing the same canonical record-to-target relationship produces the same routeId.

routeStates.WAITING_CANONICAL: No durable canonical binding exists; no route edge may be emitted.
routeStates.WAITING_CLASSIFICATION: Canonical identity exists but record-level classification is not durably bound; no semantic target may be guessed.
routeStates.REVIEW_REQUIRED: Classification is uncertain; only a governed_hold edge may be emitted until reviewed.
routeStates.ROUTED: Durable canonical identity and durable classification both exist and the idempotent route edge has been durably written.
routeStates.QUARANTINED: Governance/safety policy requires isolation while provenance remains preserved.

ontology.rule: Thread 5 consumes module/subsystem/capability/feature/canonicalTarget supplied by classification. It does not infer missing semantic targets from deployment state, gitSha, filenames, counts or worker ownership.

downstream.thread6MayConsume: ROUTED records only, plus explicit REVIEW_REQUIRED review tasks when policy permits.
downstream.thread7Audits: routeId duplicates, canonical identity duplication, classification conflicts and target conflicts.
downstream.thread8Binds: receipt/checksum/evidence pointer for durable route artifacts.
downstream.thread9Runtime: may execute routing jobs through the existing durable execution fabric; no competing executor is introduced by Thread 5.
